name: orchflows-firstmate
description: Experimental Work/Review workflows through FirstMate on Herdr, with retained libraries and assignment controls.

interface.longDescription: Standalone Orchflows variant for FirstMate/Herdr with retained workflow libraries, scoped composition and FirstMate-owned Claude/Codex launch controls. Requires a matching experimental controller and admitted task attachment.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read the FirstMate execution gate and select an admitted workflow from the retained launch catalog. FirstMate owns agent launches and delivery.
